archetypes.name: architecture
archetypes.rationale: Plan specifies a monolithic design-step0.sh with --phase flags and a merged design-step6.sh; the test harness checks for design-step0-parse/session/degraded/route/init and design-step6-prelude/cleanup as separate scripts, indicating a structural deviation from the plan.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan (plan.txt §NEW: design-step0.sh) specifies a single `design-step0.sh` with `--phase initial|resume-issue|resume-degraded` flags, and a merged `design-step6.sh` (plan.txt §NEW: design-step6.sh). However, `assert_wrapper_contract_pins` in `scripts/test-design-structure.sh` checks for separate sub-scripts: `design-step0-parse.sh`, `design-step0-session.sh`, `design-step0-degraded.sh`, `design-step0-route.sh`, `design-step0-init.sh`, `design-step6-prelude.sh`, and `design-step6-cleanup.sh`. Verify whether this decomposition is an intentional deviation from the plan or an inconsistency between the harness and the actual wrappers shipped in the diff. Also check whether `assert_direct_wrappers_are_executable_and_documented` covers sub-scripts invoked internally by wrappers but not directly from SKILL.md fences — if unchecked, internal sub-scripts could ship without executable bits or sibling `.md` files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: risk-integration
archetypes.rationale: The harness shrank from ~2050 to ~465 lines, deleting hundreds of issue-numbered contract pins (#2754, #3175, #3628, #3735, etc.) that guarded previously found regressions in brainstorm flag forwarding, plan-size KV parsing, REPO threading, and sentinel ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: The removed code in `scripts/test-design-structure.sh` contained specific regression pins with issue numbers including: `--brainstorm-requested`/`--approve-requested`/`--skip-approve-requested` forwarding to `design-init-runparams.sh`; plan-size KV parsing in SKILL.md (`SOFT_ADVISORY`, `DIFF_ADDED`, `DIFF_DELETED`, `MECHANICAL_CHURN`); `${REPO:+--repo "$REPO"}` threading through pause-save and postplan calls; brainstorm.md MANDATORY directive and ScheduleWakeup prohibition; anti-halt step sequences (`5→5a→5b→5c.1→5c.5→5c.7→5c.8→6`); and the per-turn-polling NEVER literal in orchestrator-never.md. Assess whether each deleted pin is now covered by a new wrapper-contract check in `assert_wrapper_contract_pins`, `assert_wrapper_pause_before_work`, or `assert_wrapper_fence_ordering`, or whether previously guarded regressions are now undetected. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: code-quality
archetypes.rationale: assert_design_skill_bash_fences_are_wrappers unconditionally requires --claude-pid on every SKILL.md bash fence, but the plan specifies --claude-pid only for step0 and step5c wrappers, adding noise to all other wrappers and violating KISS.
archetypes.prompt_body:
In `scripts/test-design-structure.sh`, the Python block inside `assert_design_skill_bash_fences_are_wrappers` unconditionally fails any bash fence that lacks `--claude-pid` (the check runs before the step0/step5c-specific branch), yet the plan states `--claude-pid "$PPID"` is only required on step0 and step5c wrappers. Examine whether the regex used to validate logical commands correctly handles multi-line fences after line-continuation joining (`' '.join(part.strip() for part in text.split('\
'))`), particularly whether `<PUBLIC_ARGV_WORDS>` as a bare placeholder is accepted or rejected as an arg value. Also verify that `assert_no_inline_bash_tokens_in_skill_fences` does not false-positive on legitimate wrapper argument values that happen to match token patterns like `python3` or `export` appearing inside quoted strings in fence bodies. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
